lucy.docs: opened PR #1175 to tidy up quota & pricing docs: swap examples to "cost per 1k tokens", fix dashboard panel links, and update SDK header samples. Diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1175

omar: great. which panels are broken?

lucy.docs: billing FAQ linked to panelId=90 which is now 265. updated docs and added a redirect rule.

kevin: SDK snippet check: curl and Node examples still use X-Api-Key. Suggest replacing with Authorization: Bearer and a short retry example for 429s.

lucy.docs: added Kevin's snippet and a tiny exponential backoff example.

maya: quick UX nit 1: the pricing worked example was ambiguous. I rewrote the math steps to show tokens -> 1k units -> total cost.

support: please add redirect rule so old customer emails pointing at /dashboards/usage?panelId=90 don't 404. We had two tickets about that.

lucy.docs: added redirect: "#/dashboards/usage?panelId=90  /dashboards/usage?panelId=265  301" and a docs/_redirects anchor for the old FAQ link.

omar: CI preview?

deploybot: preview build queued for branch docs/pricing-cleanup. build started at 2026-03-25T16:20:10Z.

deploybot: preview succeeded 1: https://deploy-preview-1175--docs.redwood.ai. Linkcheck passed; snippets render; redirect test OK.

kevin: LGTM. merging in 5m. I'll ping devex if any SDK nuance shows up in support cases.

lucy.docs: thanks all 1. I'll send a short note to support and accounts with the redirect mapping and the snippet changes so they can update saved docs.
